run_check_documentation: run the python script to check for missing README.md files in target directories
run_check_doxygen_comments: run the python script to check C and C++ files for missing doxygen file comments
run_check_all_docs: run the python script to validate documentation compliance across all gRPC source directories
review_check_documentation: review the python script that validates README.md and doxygen comment presence in source trees
refactor_check_documentation: refactor the python script to support Python 3 and add argparse CLI arguments
